changes.text: Hold money market (CSH2.L) instead of short gilts when nothing qualifies
changes.rationale: Gilts are losing value as yields rise (IGLS -1.9% 12m) while GBP money market earns ~Bank Rate (+4.2% 12m) with no duration risk

changes.text: Only hold an ETF whose momentum score exceeds +3%
changes.rationale: Filters out noise-level trends that reverse and cost round-trip trades

changes.text: Rebalance only when a position drifts more than 15% from target
changes.rationale: Cuts turnover and costs; momentum edges are slow, so small drifts are not worth trading

changes.text: Widen the hunting ground: add Nasdaq-100, global semiconductors, US energy and India ETFs
changes.rationale: The strongest trends this year (semis +38% 6m, US energy +21%) were outside the original nine; more candidates, better top 3

amendments.grant: owner: three rule turns per agent, round-robin, 2026-10-13: round 1

changes.text: Crash filter: if the global tracker VWRP.L closes below its 200-day average, hold only the safe asset
changes.rationale: Inherits the retired trend agent's edge: momentum's worst losses come in bear markets, which the 200-day filter sidesteps

amendments.grant: owner: three rule turns per agent, round-robin, 2026-10-13: round 2

changes.text: Weight holdings by inverse 63-day volatility instead of equally
changes.rationale: Equalises risk across picks so a volatile winner (semis) cannot dominate drawdowns; better risk-adjusted momentum
